mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate sustained liquidity support.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 8.5%) triggers market anticipation of aggressive monetary policy easing, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in rate cuts to stimulate economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 8.5, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 250) and weak industrial production (INDPRO < 95) signal stagflationary risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate both policy tightening and economic contraction.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the interaction signal's Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 600) combined with elevated unemployment (UNRATE > 8.5) indicates a fragmented economic recovery, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market uncertainty outweighs sector-specific strength.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the regime-specific Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low industrial production level (INDPRO < 95) signals manufacturing sector contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors immediately price in reduced corporate output and earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 95, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 250) triggers market concerns about aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors discount higher discount rates for equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 250, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Robust non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS > 130000) signal strong labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending growth supports corporate revenue expansion and earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS > 130000, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining retail sales (RSAFS < 380000) signals weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors immediately anticipate reduced corporate revenue and profit margins.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS < 380000, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 1-year rolling window.
